highlights.text: ServiceNow to Jira Service Management migration on track for the 26 October 2026 go-live; CMDB migrated to Jira Assets and UAT signed off.
Identity workstreams mobilised: SailPoint ISC tenant configuration and CyberArk cloud design progressing to plan.
SIEM replacement (Phase I) and SOAR automation (Phase II) aligned under a single roadmap.

lowlights.text: New Call Centre Onboarding is Red: vendor delay in office fit-out is holding up premises readiness.
AD to Entra ID Phase I sequencing affected by legacy application dependencies and hybrid identity complexity.
CRM integration complexity and market rollout dependencies under active review.

risksIssues.text: Vendor delay in office fit-out and preparation of the call centre premises is impacting infrastructure installation, workplace readiness and planned onboarding dates.
Legacy AD dependencies could push the Phase I Entra ID cutover beyond December 2027.
Firewall rule complexity and site-specific dependencies may delay full network segmentation.
CRM market rollout dependencies could compress the 2028 rollout window.

nextSteps.text: Agree a recovery plan and revised handover date with the fit-out vendor.
Complete the Jira SM cutover rehearsal and confirm go-live readiness for 26 October.
Present the PAM target architecture to the design authority (November 2026).
Complete the hybrid identity assessment and plan remediation Wave 1.

decisionsNeeded.text: Approve the call centre re-plan and an interim workplace option if the fit-out slips further.
Confirm SIEM platform selection by 13 November 2026 to protect the Phase I timeline.
Endorse the CRM pilot market and SAP E1 integration sequencing.
